claim: Source navigation and explicit gaps, not qualified support or customer acceptance

questions.question: Which certificates, keys, libraries, protocols, code, HSMs, databases, APIs and cloud services are discovered?
questions.existing_surface: Separate source/network/cloud/hardware/vendor inventories and receipt-based assurance.
questions.boundary: Presence of an adapter is not qualified support for every protocol/version or deployment. Metadata is not key extraction.
questions.acceptance_needed: Approved asset/protocol/version/access matrix with positive and negative fixtures and independent expected denominator.

questions.question: What on-prem, multi-cloud, SaaS, mainframe and legacy environments are covered?
questions.existing_surface: Cloud collectors, COBOL parser and operator-produced RACF/ICSF extracts.
questions.boundary: No universal z/OS access, arbitrary SaaS visibility, legacy executable coverage or live multi-cloud qualification.
questions.acceptance_needed: Run permitted representative platforms and denied/segmented/offline cases; record exclusions and versions.

questions.question: What third-party embedded crypto in core banking, payment switches, SWIFT and card systems is covered?
questions.existing_surface: Payment metadata, vendor profiles, supplier evidence and reviewed dependency relationships.
questions.boundary: A vendor declaration, product label or signed document is not observed embedded implementation.
questions.acceptance_needed: Product/version-specific vendor evidence and authorized exports; bank-reviewed unknowns for inaccessible components.

questions.question: How are OT/IoT, ATMs, POS and network appliances handled?
questions.existing_surface: OT scanners, hardware inventory and network metadata surfaces exist.
questions.boundary: No unrestricted probing or safe-scan certification for fragile payment/OT devices.
questions.acceptance_needed: Device-owner-approved passive/export method, lab baseline, rate/stop limits and witnessed no-disruption test.

questions.question: Can you find hardcoded keys, custom crypto and compiled-binary crypto?
questions.existing_surface: Source detectors and binary fingerprint/control-flow analysis paths exist.
questions.boundary: Obfuscation, stripped/static binaries, wrappers and proprietary primitives create false negatives; signatures are indicators.
questions.acceptance_needed: Representative sanctioned source/binary corpus, ground truth, unsupported packers/architectures and secret-redaction review.

questions.question: Which discovery methods are used and what access is needed?
questions.existing_surface: Static parsers, active metadata probes, imported extracts and binary analysis.
questions.boundary: Method and production-profile admission differ; no single agentless method sees everything.
questions.acceptance_needed: Per-source architecture/data-flow/access plan, least-privilege grant and actual deployment qualification.

questions.question: How are transit, at-rest and in-code crypto distinguished?
questions.existing_surface: Source findings, network observations, cloud/key metadata and reviewed relationships.
questions.boundary: An algorithm string does not prove encryption at rest, negotiated transport or key use.
questions.acceptance_needed: Purpose-bound evidence including actual transport negotiation, storage setting and source site; disclose inferred links.

questions.question: What happens when traffic is encrypted, segmented or inaccessible?
questions.existing_surface: Expected-estate coverage supports unresolved targets, exclusions and unavailable evidence.
questions.boundary: No decryption bypass; inaccessible scope cannot be silently counted observed.
questions.acceptance_needed: Approved vantage points or offline metadata exports; explicit inaccessible targets and review/expiry of exceptions.

questions.question: What are false-positive/false-negative rates and how are they validated?
questions.existing_surface: Existing approved/frozen sample workflow plus corrected legacy triage denominators, explicit unmeasured metrics, validated workbooks and consistent CLI scoring.
questions.boundary: Reviewed file/algorithm units are not all-bank recall. No true-negative denominator is supplied by legacy workbooks, so no false-positive rate is claimed. Existing separate corpus evaluator conventions are not globally requalified.
questions.acceptance_needed: Bank-agreed corpus/version/method, confusion matrix, missed classes, confidence intervals and independent retest.

questions.question: Can algorithm, key size, mode and quantum vulnerability be distinguished?
questions.existing_surface: Shared classifier plus explicit PQC public-key byte units, native FIPS parameter-set identifiers and all twelve full SLH-DSA parameter names.
questions.boundary: Algorithm recognition and catalog sizes are not observed key usage, implementation correctness, module validation or global current-policy approval. Legacy input key_size units remain unverified for PQC.
questions.acceptance_needed: Known/unknown/alias/suite/key-size fixtures and independently checked observations for the bank workload.

questions.question: Can existing hybrid/PQC implementations such as ML-KEM in TLS be detected?
questions.existing_surface: Registry recognizes hybrid names; inventory/planning now separates candidates from verified readiness.
questions.boundary: A library, group name, supported-groups advertisement or vendor roadmap is not negotiated hybrid traffic.
questions.acceptance_needed: Capture permitted actual handshake/group and authentication evidence; test fallback/downgrade and unsupported peers.

questions.question: Which CBOM formats and schema versions are available?
questions.existing_surface: Legacy compatibility exporters plus native CycloneDX1.6 JSON with pinned full upstream schema, offline validation and local reference integrity.
questions.boundary: Native1.6 is an allowlisted metadata profile, JSON only; not lossless arbitrary-document conversion. Legacy1.5 JSON/XML are not newly standard-qualified. Schema validity is not bank or third-party tooling acceptance.
questions.acceptance_needed: Validate requested schema/version and all six semantics; customer import round trip, provenance, unsupported fields and signing trust.

questions.question: How are sensitivity, shelf life, HNDL, exposure and criticality prioritized?
questions.existing_surface: Deterministic risk and business context; unknown retention remains unknown and signing-only use is not ciphertext HNDL.
questions.boundary: Model defaults and inferred data classes are not bank-approved classifications; public-key signature migration remains important.
questions.acceptance_needed: Bank owner supplies confidentiality retention, purpose, exposure/criticality and validates resulting ordering.

questions.question: Can findings be mapped to Mosca inequality?
questions.existing_surface: Validated finite nonnegative scenario inputs, explicit assumption labels and zero-margin handling.
questions.boundary: Threat year is an assumption, not a prediction, regulatory date or SLA; year resolution is coarse.
questions.acceptance_needed: Bank-approved retention/migration/threat scenarios and sensitivity analysis, with missing-input outcomes retained.

questions.question: Can findings map to applications, owners and classifications?
questions.existing_surface: Existing business-system links plus native export of supplied application, owner, classification and retention context; shared assets retain multiple contexts without duplicate references.
questions.boundary: Business context is supplied metadata, not independently verified ownership/classification; import does not automatically create CMDB mappings.
questions.acceptance_needed: CMDB reconciliation, active owners, classification approval and unmatched/ambiguous mapping review.

questions.question: Do dependencies show what breaks if an algorithm is replaced?
questions.existing_surface: Evidence-bound relationship paths and graph/impact surfaces.
questions.boundary: A dependency path or simulation is not causal proof or a change-safety guarantee.
questions.acceptance_needed: Trace exact source/build/deployment and perform isolated interoperability/failure/rollback tests.

questions.question: How are FIPS203/204/205 and evolving FN-DSA/HQC standards handled?
questions.existing_surface: Registry screens ML-KEM/ML-DSA/SLH-DSA families and full FIPS205 variants; FN-DSA/Falcon/HQC/McEliece do not receive automatic policy approval from draft/selected labels.
questions.boundary: No live NIST publication refresh or regulator interpretation was performed. Conservative registry status is not a claim about the latest legal publication state or implementation certification.
questions.acceptance_needed: Record exact standard/revision/final status, implementation parameters and independent compatibility/validation evidence.

questions.question: How are SP800-131A and2030/2035 transition statements handled?
questions.existing_surface: Legacy roadmap explicitly labeled historical draft planning; general framework dates no longer become PQC mandates.
questions.boundary: Do not conflate SP800-131A, draft IR8547 targets, threat scenarios and institution-specific obligations.
questions.acceptance_needed: Compliance owner approves current publication/version, jurisdiction, primitive/use and applicability before deadlines bind.

questions.question: Does output support central bank, PCI DSS, DORA, EBA, MAS, FFIEC and BIS expectations?
questions.existing_surface: Evidence exports, control/register and banking action-plan surfaces.
questions.boundary: Mapping and reports are not regulator acceptance, certification or a universal legal interpretation.
questions.acceptance_needed: Bank compliance/legal review of each applicable obligation and evidence sufficiency, including unresolved exceptions.

questions.question: How are evolving standards/guidance kept current?
questions.existing_surface: Version-controlled registry/policy definitions and reviewed release procedures.
questions.boundary: A static catalog cannot promise live legal updates or silent safe changes.
questions.acceptance_needed: Named policy steward, authoritative-source/version/change log, review schedule and regression/customer notification process.

questions.question: Where is data stored and can sensitive material leave the environment?
questions.existing_surface: Evidence storage boundaries, safe-finding shaping and deployment residency controls.
questions.boundary: Metadata-only intent is not proof: source/log extracts can contain secrets; end-to-end collection/export must be reviewed.
questions.acceptance_needed: Bank-approved data-flow/residency map, minimization/redaction samples, retention, egress controls and incident obligations.

questions.question: What privileges are required and how are they controlled/audited?
questions.existing_surface: RBAC, durable human sessions, audit and explicit controlled execution policy.
questions.boundary: Dedicated dispatcher/daemon access is privileged; a read-only collector label does not remove host risks.
questions.acceptance_needed: Least-privilege identity per source, scoped secrets, approval/revocation audit and hostile/denied-access exercise.

questions.question: Can deployment be fully on-prem or air-gapped?
questions.existing_surface: On-prem reference profile, offline package verification and air-gap guidance.
questions.boundary: Reference procedures are not a qualified customer installation or a complete offline update/supply chain.
questions.acceptance_needed: Witness install/upgrade/restore with approved offline images/wheels/trust keys and no unauthorized egress.

questions.question: Which ISO27001/SOC2 certifications and pentest reports can be supplied?
questions.existing_surface: Existing independent security report intake and declared evidence review.
questions.boundary: No corporate certification, assessor independence or actual pentest is invented.
questions.acceptance_needed: Actual current scoped certificate/report, authorized disclosure, findings and independent retests.

questions.question: What production scan impact is demonstrated, particularly payments/trading?
questions.existing_surface: Bounded execution budgets, explicit limits and selected benchmark tooling.
questions.boundary: No bank-shaped latency/throughput/SLO qualification from tiny local tests; active OT/payment probes may be unsafe.
questions.acceptance_needed: Agree targets and noninterference limits before measurement; representative peak/failure workload, abort and cleanup proof.

questions.question: Which CMDB/SIEM/GRC/PKI/secrets/ticketing integrations work?
questions.existing_surface: Integration/event/export and business-context surfaces.
questions.boundary: A connector name/API scaffold is not a bank-tested bidirectional workflow or reliable delivery.
questions.acceptance_needed: Version/auth/data mapping, least privilege, idempotency, timeout/delivery receipt, retry/dead-letter and revocation tests.

questions.question: Is discovery continuous or point-in-time?
questions.existing_surface: Monitor scheduling/drift and retained point-in-time records.
questions.boundary: Scheduled execution is not uninterrupted monitoring, coverage completeness or staffed incident response.
questions.acceptance_needed: Define observation freshness, missed windows, drift recheck, downtime/recovery and operational response ownership.

questions.question: Which HSM/key-management interfaces are supported?
questions.existing_surface: PKCS11 metadata and HSM/cloud KMS inventory surfaces.
questions.boundary: A model/family or declared mechanism does not prove installed firmware, FIPS scope, permission or live throughput.
questions.acceptance_needed: Exact vendor/model/firmware/provider/mechanism matrix; authorized no-key-export test and separate runtime qualification.

questions.question: What APIs and reporting capabilities are offered?
questions.existing_surface: Authenticated API schemas, assurance history and export/report surfaces.
questions.boundary: No blanket API compatibility, pagination completeness or delivery assurance without contract tests.
questions.acceptance_needed: Customer API contract, scopes, limits, pagination/error semantics, export verification and version lifecycle.

questions.question: Is there a migration roadmap, agility assessment and remediation guidance?
questions.existing_surface: Deterministic workstreams/waves, agility and evidence-bound remediation.
questions.boundary: A recommendation or reported completion is not a verified fix; migration needs deployment and interoperability evidence.
questions.acceptance_needed: Named owner, exact before/after predicate, representative rescan, independent verification and rollback boundary.

questions.question: Can PQC latency, packets/certificates and HSM throughput be benchmarked?
questions.existing_surface: PQC impact and performance tools exist.
questions.boundary: Estimates/simulation are not measured negotiated payload size, real HSM throughput or production SLO.
questions.acceptance_needed: Pre-agreed matched classical/hybrid/PQC workloads on exact versions/hardware; percentile/distribution, failure and size observations.

questions.question: Can PKI/CLM transitions, hybrid certificates and pilots be supported?
questions.existing_surface: Certificate lifecycle, composite-name handling and bounded pilot records.
questions.boundary: Parsing a hybrid name is not valid certificate-chain/client interoperability or production key ceremony qualification.
questions.acceptance_needed: Approved test CA and clients, chain/path/downgrade/revocation/expiry cases, rollback and separate pilot acceptance.

questions.question: Which HSM, PKI or network vendor partnerships are established?
questions.existing_surface: Vendor due-diligence evidence can be retained.
questions.boundary: No partnership, joint support or certification is inferred from compatibility code or a vendor name.
questions.acceptance_needed: Actual agreements, named contacts, supported versions and authorized joint-test/support evidence.

questions.question: Can crypto-governance policy and an agility framework be developed?
questions.existing_surface: Policy definitions, owners, evidence registers and review workflow.
questions.boundary: Software cannot appoint authority or determine legal policy for the bank.
questions.acceptance_needed: Bank-approved decision rights, cryptographic use policy, exceptions/expiry, changes, training and governance minutes.

questions.question: What delivery timeline and bank effort are realistic?
questions.existing_surface: Scope/qualification/runbook structure for a bounded pilot.
questions.boundary: No typical bank duration or effort claimed without size, access, integration and approval inputs.
questions.acceptance_needed: Joint scope and resource estimate with prerequisites, milestones, acceptance, dependencies and change control.

questions.question: Which comparable regulated references can be contacted?
questions.existing_surface: Evidence/profile records can hold authorized references.
questions.boundary: No bank customer, testimonial or reference is invented.
questions.acceptance_needed: Consent-based actual comparable references and independently confirmed delivery scope/results.

questions.question: How is pricing structured and what drives cost growth?
questions.existing_surface: Operational limits and workload concepts are available.
questions.boundary: No fabricated price, subscription entitlement or commercial commitment.
questions.acceptance_needed: Signed pricing basis, asset dedup/revision counting, scans/API/storage/egress/connector limits and overage/exit costs.

questions.question: What SLA, support and data-residency commitments are agreed?
questions.existing_surface: Accountable-duty and residency review boundaries.
questions.boundary: Intended24/7 and weekly review are not staffed support or a contractual SLA.
questions.acceptance_needed: Actual primary/backup roster, support hours/timezone, escalation/response commitments, residency and legal agreement.

questions.question: What happens to bank data/CBOM at exit?
questions.existing_surface: Exports, offboarding/retention duties and backup procedures.
questions.boundary: Export success does not prove completeness, deletion from backups/subprocessors or revocation of every consumer.
questions.acceptance_needed: Witness portable verified export, trust/signature handling, restore/readability, revocation and retention/deletion evidence.

questions.question: What financial stability and product PQC transition roadmap are demonstrated?
questions.existing_surface: Supplier profile can retain finance/succession evidence; product crypto is separately inventoried.
questions.boundary: No audited accounts, escrow/succession guarantee or own-product PQC compliance is created by a registry entry.
questions.acceptance_needed: Actual finance/continuity evidence and source/image/protocol/key/signing inventory with tested product transition plan.

questions.question: What third-party/open-source scanning supply-chain risks exist?
questions.existing_surface: Dependency locks, source/image binding and parser isolation.
questions.boundary: Pinned inputs are not signed build provenance, license clearance, zero CVEs or safe upstream code.
questions.acceptance_needed: Reviewed SBOM/licenses/advisories, patched immutable images, provenance, independent review and offline update path.

questions.question: What are known limitations and blind spots?
questions.existing_surface: Scope declarations, coverage blockers and accuracy blind spots.
questions.boundary: No claim of universal scanning, proprietary primitive identification or full-bank completeness.
questions.acceptance_needed: Sign the allowed methods/platform matrix and retain unobserved/unsupported/stale/inconclusive classes.

questions.question: Can a comparable sample CBOM/report be shown?
questions.existing_surface: A committed synthetic banking-like eight-record native1.6 CBOM and actual planning-engine report are reproducible locally.
questions.boundary: Synthetic supplied inputs are not a comparable customer engagement or scanner execution; no bank reference or independent discovery accuracy follows.
questions.acceptance_needed: Consent-based comparable evidence or labeled synthetic six-BOM sample validated by the bank consumer.

questions.question: How is inaccessible third-party SaaS handled?
questions.existing_surface: Supplier evidence and expected-estate registers retain unknown/excluded scope.
questions.boundary: No visibility is fabricated through proprietary SaaS or a vendor signature.
questions.acceptance_needed: Authorized provider exports/assessor evidence, service/version scope, contractual cooperation and explicit residual risk.

questions.question: How is discovery completeness proved to auditors/regulators?
questions.existing_surface: Independent expected-estate denominator and scoped receipts with current evidence checks.
questions.boundary: Zero findings, signed CBOM,100% of returned records or a successful scan cannot prove an unknown universe complete.
questions.acceptance_needed: Reconcile independently maintained CMDB/cloud/network/application/vendor sets, permitted methods, freshness and omissions; separately review.

questions.question: Authorization and rules of engagement
questions.existing_surface: Existing control/evidence surfaces; no new service or screen.
questions.boundary: This control requires explicit bank acceptance, not a product-name assertion.
questions.acceptance_needed: Explicit per-target permission, access windows, identity and stop authority; no unauthorized scan.

questions.question: Completeness denominator and inaccessible scope
questions.existing_surface: Existing control/evidence surfaces; no new service or screen.
questions.boundary: This control requires explicit bank acceptance, not a product-name assertion.
questions.acceptance_needed: Bank-owned expected inventory; unresolved, stale, excluded and unsupported targets stay visible.

questions.question: Evidence freshness and provenance
questions.existing_surface: Existing control/evidence surfaces; no new service or screen.
questions.boundary: This control requires explicit bank acceptance, not a product-name assertion.
questions.acceptance_needed: Capture time, exact artifact/source/method, integrity and expiry; historic verification is not current proof.

questions.question: Non-disruption, abort and uncertain outcomes
questions.existing_surface: Existing control/evidence surfaces; no new service or screen.
questions.boundary: This control requires explicit bank acceptance, not a product-name assertion.
questions.acceptance_needed: Agreed scan budgets and emergency stop; no retry of UNKNOWN external outcome without reconciliation.

questions.question: Tenant isolation and privileged insider threats
questions.existing_surface: Existing control/evidence surfaces; no new service or screen.
questions.boundary: This control requires explicit bank acceptance, not a product-name assertion.
questions.acceptance_needed: Cross-bank read/write/export/cache/session tests and dedicated privileged worker boundary.

questions.question: Incident disclosure, breach notification and vulnerability handling
questions.existing_surface: Existing control/evidence surfaces; no new service or screen.
questions.boundary: This control requires explicit bank acceptance, not a product-name assertion.
questions.acceptance_needed: Actual reporting route, bank notification obligations, accountable responders and reviewed retests.

questions.question: CBOM schema, portability and licensing
questions.existing_surface: Existing control/evidence surfaces; no new service or screen.
questions.boundary: This control requires explicit bank acceptance, not a product-name assertion.
questions.acceptance_needed: Exact format/version, stable IDs, provenance, six-BOM semantics, license terms and consumer round trip.

questions.question: Exit verification including backups and subprocessors
questions.existing_surface: Existing control/evidence surfaces; no new service or screen.
questions.boundary: This control requires explicit bank acceptance, not a product-name assertion.
questions.acceptance_needed: Export validation, key/access revocation, legal retention/deletion limits and processor attestations.

questions.question: Policy source status and applicability
questions.existing_surface: Existing control/evidence surfaces; no new service or screen.
questions.boundary: This control requires explicit bank acceptance, not a product-name assertion.
questions.acceptance_needed: Current authoritative publication/revision, draft versus final, jurisdiction and bank-approved effective dates.

questions.question: Observed versus inferred dependencies
questions.existing_surface: Existing control/evidence surfaces; no new service or screen.
questions.boundary: This control requires explicit bank acceptance, not a product-name assertion.
questions.acceptance_needed: Evidence class for each edge; no causal impact or safe migration guarantee from graph reachability.

questions.question: Hybrid/PQC interoperability and downgrade resistance
questions.existing_surface: Existing control/evidence surfaces; no new service or screen.
questions.boundary: This control requires explicit bank acceptance, not a product-name assertion.
questions.acceptance_needed: Actual negotiation and authentication, fallback, chain/packet size, middlebox and legacy-client cases.

questions.question: Product self-transition and recovery of trust
questions.existing_surface: Existing control/evidence surfaces; no new service or screen.
questions.boundary: This control requires explicit bank acceptance, not a product-name assertion.
questions.acceptance_needed: Own TLS/SSO/artifact/report signatures and long-lived evidence keys; rotation, offline verification and backup restore.
